category_title: Students with limited fine motor control using responsive digital media
scenario_title: Colouring activity with limited fine motor control
minimal_context: Robert is sitting in his special school classroom, tasked with coloring in an animal-related scene using traditional pencils.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Here is a printed picture of a cow. Please use these traditional pencils to color in the animal scene.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Reaches for a pencil, expending considerable effort in controlling his hand movements just to pick it up.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: What part do you want to color first?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Points to the cow's legs, taking time to try and position the pencil precisely on the small section.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Go ahead and color it in.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Struggles to move the pencil across the paper, ultimately unable to achieve the successfully accomplished process and product of coloring in with the traditional pencils.)

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Here is a printed picture of a cow. Please use these traditional pencils to color in the animal scene.

STUDENT: (Reaches for a pencil, expending considerable effort in controlling his hand movements just to pick it up.)

TUTOR: What part do you want to color first?

STUDENT: (Points to the cow's legs, taking time to try and position the pencil precisely on the small section.)

TUTOR: Go ahead and color it in.

STUDENT: (Struggles to move the pencil across the paper, ultimately unable to achieve the successfully accomplished process and product of coloring in with the traditional pencils.)

context.materials: iPad, 'My Colouring Book FreeTM' app, traditional pencils or pens
